The upper half-circle has a total angle of \(180^\circ\). The angle between \(OA\) and the unlabeled upper-left radius is

\[
180^\circ-(40^\circ+55^\circ+35^\circ)=50^\circ.
\]

Thus, the central angle of the shaded sector is

\[
50^\circ+40^\circ=90^\circ.
\]

Because the sector and disk have the same radius, their area ratio equals the ratio of their central angles:

\[
P=\frac{90^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac14.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac14}
\]
